comments.body:
Only few people recognize the real importance of this dress, probably OGP neither.
+2 Fabric and +3 Textile doesnt matter but +1 Sewing is much more significant than it appears. Try to count how many sewing boosts available for us beside sewing aide. The reason for excluding aide is the very core.
